description: MemoryBackend::query_changes ignores filter, sort, max_changes, up_to_id, and collapse_threads (all prefixed with _). The method doc says 'Return the full current id list as added when since_query_state == 0; otherwise return empty changes.' This limitation means any test exercising query_changes with a filter or since_state \!= '0' will silently receive wrong data. The limitation comment is only on the method body; the parameter names are _ which hides it in IDE hover. The struct-level doc on MemoryBackend should list this as a known limitation so test authors don't write tests that appear to test filtering but actually test nothing.
title: common/mod.rs: MemoryBackend query_changes stub limitation not visible at call sites
